title: ipomoea buchananii var. woodii
intro: Ipomoea buchananii var. woodii, commonly known as Wood's Blue Passion Flower or Wood's Passion Flower, is a plant species within the Convolvulaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its potential to aid in the treatment of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Research on the plant has identified a variety of bioactive compounds, including aristolochic acid and other alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
